WITH input_data AS (
  SELECT
    {{ $json.user_id }}::BIGINT AS user_id,
    {{ $json.chat_id }}::BIGINT AS chat_id,

    {{ $json.pending_message_id || 'NULL' }}::BIGINT AS pending_message_id,
    {{ $json.message_uuid ? "'" + String($json.message_uuid).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'::UUID" : "NULL::UUID" }} AS message_uuid,

    '{{ String($json.message_type || "text").replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::TEXT AS message_type,

    {{ $json.message_for_ai ? "'" + String($json.message_for_ai).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "NULL" }}::TEXT AS message_for_ai,

    {{ $json.ai_summary ? "'" + String($json.ai_summary).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "NULL" }}::TEXT AS ai_summary,
    {{ $json.ai_category ? "'" + String($json.ai_category).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "NULL" }}::TEXT AS ai_category,
    {{ $json.ai_detected_type ? "'" + String($json.ai_detected_type).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "NULL" }}::TEXT AS ai_detected_type,
    {{ $json.ai_language ? "'" + String($json.ai_language).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "NULL" }}::TEXT AS ai_language,

    {{ $json.ai_confidence !== null && $json.ai_confidence !== undefined ? Number($json.ai_confidence) : 0 }}::NUMERIC AS ai_confidence,

    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.ai_entities || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::JSONB AS entities_json,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.ai_important_details || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::JSONB AS important_details_json,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.ai_raw_json || {}).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::JSONB AS raw_ai_json,
    '{{ JSON.stringify($json.ai_business_card_data || null).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::JSONB AS business_card_data_json,

    {{ $json.ai_content ? "'" + String($json.ai_content).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "NULL" }}::TEXT AS ai_content,
    {{ $json.ai_raw_text ? "'" + String($json.ai_raw_text).replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : "NULL" }}::TEXT AS ai_raw_text
),

prepared AS (
  SELECT
    *,

    CASE
      WHEN business_card_data_json->>'is_business_card' = 'true'
        THEN 'business_card'
      WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(ai_summary, '')) LIKE '%business card%'
        THEN 'business_card'
      WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(ai_summary, '')) LIKE '%general agent%'
        THEN 'business_card'
      WHEN COALESCE(message_for_ai, '') LIKE '%主营业务%'
        THEN 'business_card'
      WHEN COALESCE(message_for_ai, '') LIKE '%总代理%'
        THEN 'business_card'
      WHEN COALESCE(message_for_ai, '') LIKE '%进口%'
        THEN 'business_card'
      ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ai_category), ''), 'note')
    END AS final_category,

    CASE
      WHEN business_card_data_json->>'is_business_card' = 'true'
        THEN 'business_card'
      WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(ai_summary, '')) LIKE '%business card%'
        THEN 'business_card'
      WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(ai_summary, '')) LIKE '%general agent%'
        THEN 'business_card'
      ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ai_detected_type), ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ai_category), ''), 'note'))
    END AS final_detected_type,

    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(message_for_ai, '') ~ '[\u4e00-\u9fff]'
        THEN 'zh'
      WHEN COALESCE(ai_content, '') ~ '[\u4e00-\u9fff]'
        THEN 'zh'
      WHEN COALESCE(ai_raw_text, '') ~ '[\u4e00-\u9fff]'
        THEN 'zh'
      ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ai_language), ''), 'unknown')
    END AS final_language,

    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ai_summary), ''), 'No summary available') AS final_summary,

    LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(ai_confidence, 0), 0), 1) AS final_confidence
  FROM input_data
),

final_prepared AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(ai_content), ''),
      CONCAT_WS(
        E'\n',
        'Summary: ' || final_summary,
        'Category: ' || final_category,
        'Detected type: ' || final_detected_type,
        'Language: ' || final_language,
        'Entities: ' || COALESCE(entities_json::TEXT, '[]'),
        'Important details: ' || COALESCE(important_details_json::TEXT, '[]'),
        'Business card data: ' || COALESCE(business_card_data_json::TEXT, 'null'),
        'Message: ' || COALESCE(message_for_ai, '')
      )
    ) AS final_ai_content
  FROM prepared
),

metadata_upsert AS (
  INSERT INTO gnote.message_ai_metadata (
    pending_message_id,
    message_uuid,
    user_id,
    source_status,

    summary,
    detected_type,
    category,
    language,

    keywords,
    suggested_topics,
    entities,
    important_details,

    confidence,
    raw_ai_json,
    business_card_data,
    ai_content,

    model_name,
    analysis_status,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    pending_message_id,
    message_uuid,
    user_id,
    'pending',

    final_summary,
    final_detected_type,
    final_category,
    final_language,

    '[]'::JSONB,
    '[]'::JSONB,
    entities_json,
    important_details_json,

    final_confidence,
    raw_ai_json,
    business_card_data_json,
    final_ai_content,

    'gemini',
    'done',
    NOW(),
    NOW()
  FROM final_prepared
  WHERE pending_message_id IS NOT NULL

  ON CONFLICT (pending_message_id)
  WHERE pending_message_id IS NOT NULL
  DO UPDATE SET
    message_uuid = EXCLUDED.message_uuid,
    user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id,
    source_status = 'pending',

    summary = EXCLUDED.summary,
    detected_type = EXCLUDED.detected_type,
    category = EXCLUDED.category,
    language = EXCLUDED.language,

    suggested_topics = EXCLUDED.suggested_topics,
    entities = EXCLUDED.entities,
    important_details = EXCLUDED.important_details,

    confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence,
    raw_ai_json = EXCLUDED.raw_ai_json,
    business_card_data = EXCLUDED.business_card_data,
    ai_content = EXCLUDED.ai_content,

    model_name = EXCLUDED.model_name,
    analysis_status = EXCLUDED.analysis_status,
    updated_at = NOW()

  RETURNING id
)

SELECT
  user_id,
  chat_id,
  pending_message_id,
  message_uuid,
  message_type,
  message_for_ai,

  final_summary AS ai_summary,
  final_category AS ai_category,
  final_detected_type AS ai_detected_type,
  final_language AS ai_language,
  final_confidence AS ai_confidence,

  '[]'::JSONB AS ai_keywords,
  entities_json AS ai_entities,
  important_details_json AS ai_important_details,
  raw_ai_json AS ai_raw_json,
  business_card_data_json AS ai_business_card_data,

  ai_raw_text AS text,

  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM metadata_upsert) AS metadata_rows,
  0 AS index_rows
FROM final_prepared;
